Description: "The resetAllLocalMemoryStates function was missing ~30+ state variables, causing POS data to leak across login sessions. This adds resets for: nextBillNo, stats, chart data (topItems/pieItems/lineData/barData), selectedTable, searchQuery, billingView, orderType, subOrderType, activeTrayTab, preOrders, previewReceipt, editingOrder, split payment states, selectedWaiter, selectedRiderId, ebillEnabled, selectedCategory, selectedPriceTier, digital order states, modal states, and more. Every useState in the component is now reset to its default on logout."
Instruction: "Add all missing state variable resets to resetAllLocalMemoryStates to ensure every transactional and UI state is cleared on logout/startup"
